versions.changelog:
- Updated description to emphasize PubMed RAG and OSCE evaluation features.
- Updated version number to 2.1.0.
- Added OpenCLAW metadata, including emoji, homepage link, and supported operating systems.
- Removed license, compatibility, agents, price_per_execution, ecosystem, and publishable fields from metadata.

Initial release of Nexus Clinical Case Gen – a tool for generating interactive clinical case scenarios for medical education.

- Generates clinical cases, differential diagnoses, and OSCE scenarios with references
- Integrates PubMed retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and competency tracking
- Features structured results with severity classification, impact/effort scoring, and confidence scoring
- Outputs are cross-validated with at least two independent sources
- Offers $5.00 per execution pricing with enterprise and volume discount options
